explanation: Evidence only supports PFS medians (24.8 vs 14.5 months). The HR~0.58, P<0.001, ORR (42.1% vs 34.7%), time-to-chemotherapy (38.1 vs 29.8 months, HR 0.73), and 'no new safety signals' are not established by the provided evidence.
suggested_rewrite: Remove or separately source the HR/P-value, ORR, time-to-chemotherapy, and safety-signal claims; retain only the PFS medians (24.8 vs 14.5 months) as supported.
